title: Sunrise Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Sunrise is the best Seaside escape with a prime location just 4 houses to the beach on East Ruskin and only a 1/2 block to Seaside Central Square; featuring the Seaside Amphitheater, 30A Air Stream Row, Modica Market Grocery. Perfect for small families!
description_expanded: Description37 EAST RUSKIN STREET1 KING, 1 QUEEN SOFA SLEEPER - sleeps 4 - RenovationRemodeled Winter 2026, new furnishings, new full size washer dryer,kitchen updates and more. New images June 2026. Sunrise, Newly Remodeled Seaside Guest Cottage Steps from the BeachSunrise is a beautifully remodeled and thoughtfully updated guest cottage located on Seaside’s picturesque East Ruskin Street. Just 194 feet from the beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion and only one block from Seaside’s town center, this prime location places more than 40 shops, restaurants, and cafés within a short, effortless walk—making Sunrise an ideal home base for experiencing Seaside at its best.Private Outdoor Living with Lush GreeneryGuests arrive via a classic Seaside sandy footpath leading to the cottage entry and an open-air furnished front deck . The open air front deck is the prime location to enjoy morning coffee or an evening night cap while lisetening to waves crash nearby. This inviting space a charcoal grill and a small footwash station for freshening up after a long day at the beach. First-Floor Primary Suite, Luxuriously Luxuriously AppointedThe first level features the king primary bedroom down with ensuite bathroom, new furnishings, and custom built-in storage and cabinetry. A mounted flat-screen TV and modern conveniences ensure comfort throughout your stay. The adjacent bathroom has been fully remodeled and includes a single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower, offering a spa-like retreat after a day at the beach. There is a new full size washer and dryer for longer stays.Light-Filled Living & Designer Kitchen UpstairsThe updated second floor serves as the main living level, showcasing an updated kitchen with a with several new kitchen appliances. The updated kitchen includes quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, a European dishwasher that accommodates six place setttings, a European 24 inch refrigerator with ice maker, two-burner electric cooktop, and a mounted microwave with convection oven functionality (note: no full-size oven). The kitchen is fully stocked with new dishware and ample chef-quality cookware, making meals at home easy and enjoyable.Adjacent to the kitchen, the light filled living area is furnished with all-new designer seating, including a plush queen sleeper sofa accommodating two additional guests, and a large mounted flat-screen TV—ideal for cozy movie nights. A designated bistro-style dining area for two sits just off the living and dining space, perfect for casual meals or morning coffee.Prime Location for the Ultimate Seaside GetawayWith its exceptional location just steps from the beach and moments from town, Sunrise offers the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and walkability. Whether you’re strolling to the shoreline, browsing local boutiques, or dining at one of Seaside’s renowned restaurants, everything is just a three-minute walk from your door. Let the newly reimagined Sunrise be the setting for your next unforgettable Seaside escape.Need more space, check out the main cottage A Beautiful Day.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES480 square feet1-minute walk (194 feet) to beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion, the largest stretch of private residential beaches on 30AOutdoor dining deckOutdoor foot wash station off front deck Private charcoal grillPeacock Alley Linen Partner — fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the cottageAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis and 3 pickle ball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided1 parking pass issued (a golf cart is considered a car; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited—special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit)No pets allowedSTR23-002135
